To determine the rat plasma protein binding, the plasma is diluted to 50 % with pH 7.4 phosphate buffer and warmed to 37 C before adding test compounds achieving 5 uM concentration. The dialysis buffer is added to one side of the chamber of the RED device, and the incubation is initiated by the addition of 300 uL of the test compound protein solution to the opposing chamber. The samples are incubated for 4 hours. Equal volumes from the buffer and the plasma chambers are transferred into separate wells. 50 uL of 50 % blank plasma are added to the buffer samples, and 50 uL of buffer are added to the 50 % plasma samples to ensure matrix matching of samples from both the free and bound fractions. Acetonitrile containing internal standard are added to precipitate the protein. The supernatants are analyzed by LC-MS/MS and the results are calculated. The assay has been performed by Concept Life Sciences Ltd.
